scenario.catching_architecture: A2 generated-SSOT two-direction completeness gate: Direction A fail-closes on a registry id with no non-empty generated file; Direction B fail-closes on a generated file with no registry id.
scenario.on_this_estate: ARC-0010 registry.json has 10 entries. Generated root command-center/control-plane/A2/generated has 0 files. Direction A count=10. Direction B count=0. Today this tree fails Direction A (generator never wrote the A2 outputs). Direction B is zero because nothing was generated; that zero is trusted only after detector-control found a planted unregistered file on a fixture tree.
procedure: 1. Load the typed registry (ARC-0010 registry.json) and map each entry to command-center/control-plane/A2/generated/<kind>/<id>.<ext>.
2. Direction A: every registry id whose mapped path is missing or empty is an orphan registry row.
3. Direction B: every file under the generated root whose path is not in the mapped set is an orphan output.
4. Detector-control: on a fixture, plant a known missing output and a known extra file; refuse to report zero in a direction that cannot find its known orphan.
5. Both-states: delete one output and assert A fires then restore and assert A is silent; add an unregistered file and assert B fires then remove and assert B is silent.
6. Run both directions on the live worktree and record the two counts separately.

strongest_surviving_counterargument: Path completeness is necessary and still not sufficient: FM-STALE-BYTES (reviewer-added) is green under both directions when a generated file is present at the mapped path but holds bytes from an older generator. On this tree A2 DESIGN.json is also absent, so the live pairing uses the ARC-0010 registry as the typed registry stand-in rather than a closed A2 dossier. That limitation does not excuse combining Direction A and B into one count, and it does not make today's Direction A miss (10 orphan registry rows, 0 generated files) go away. Strongest surviving FOR: a two-direction path gate still fail-closes the silent-skip class that A1 DESIGN encodes as unlisted_file, which is the point of A2 relative to A1.
